text: Customizes Random Affixes of non-Legendary gear.
After the Craft feature is unlocked as you progress through the main story, you can craft non-Legendary gear at [Arms Dealer - Geely] in the Town to customize Random Affixes on custom gear.
Crafting allows to add or replace the affix at specified slot on a piece of gear with another affix from specified Affix Pool by consuming the corresponding amount of Embers and Flame Fuel.

The Affix Pool consists of Basic Affixes, Advanced Affixes, and Ultimate Affixes. Only Priceless gear can be crafted with Ultimate Affixes, and each piece of gear can have up to 2 Advanced Affixes and 2 Ultimate Affixes.
Truth Embers can be used to re-roll the values of all Random Affixes on a piece of gear.
